title: Compassions Above; Hidden and Manifest Members
description: The Lord's grief at what he sees, and the body of his outgoing surveyed. T59 — the three compassions of the Lord at the registers where life proceeds, where the Divine Human stands, and where the call goes forth; the divine bent in pity over the soul still mingled. T60 — the four weepings of the rational: three at descent under necessity (knowing what the self will do) and a fourth at the consummation, mourning those who prepared themselves for falsity and so are cut off from rest. T61 — the body of the divine outgoing as analogous to the human body: the Father hidden within as interior members, the two ships of light shining as eyes openly manifest, Jesus the Radiance as the speaking tongue declaring everything within and without — the wound and the healing alike.
